mcq_fix.s: Match List-I with List-II: List-I (Organisation) a. Andhra Mahila Sabha b. Progressive Organisation of Women c. Stree Shakti Sanghatana d. Mahila Dakshata Samiti List-II (Year) i. 1978 ii. 1937 iii. 1977 iv. 1974 Choose the correct answer using the code given below.
mcq_fix.why: Mahila Dakshata Samiti was founded in 1977 (Suman Krishnakant, Delhi), not 1990

notes_fix.replace: 1977 — Mahila Dakshata Samiti: Suman Krishnakant (AP branches later)

patterns: No PYQs filed: APPSC would likely ask direct org-founder-year items (Andhra Mahila Sabha 1937, POW 1974, Stree Shakti Sanghatana 1978).
AP 'firsts' (first woman Governor Sharda Mukherjee, first woman Speaker Pratibha Bharati) and the 1986 AP coparcenary amendment are natural single-fact items.
Devadasi/Jogini laws (Madras 1947, AP 1988) and Bhagya Reddy Varma's 1919 demand give the AP social-reform tilt.
App mixes in national schemes (BBBP, Sashakt Panchayat Netri) that sit outside the 1956-2014 frame.
